name: Hotel Oberwirt
beschreibung: Hotel Oberwirt is centrally located in Ebbs near Kufstein, serving as an ideal base for exploring the surrounding mountains. The hotel combines authentic Tyrolean character with warm hospitality. Guest rooms feature a blend of modern amenities and alpine wood finishes. The dining room specializes in regional produce and classic Austrian recipes. The surrounding Kaiserwinkl and Kaisergebirge regions offer rich hiking and winter sports, backed by a relaxing wellness area.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Oberwirt in Ebbs in the Kufstein region provides traditional Tyrolean charm, a sauna wellness area, authentic Austrian dining, and proximity to the Kaiser Mountains.
